database: AWS RDS PostgreSQL with verified TLS

features.SafePurchase: Optional on single and collection listings. Requests persist in private messages. Selection and completed inspection have separate badges; a manual sale cannot verify payment.
features.wallet: Own-account pending/available proceeds and history from confirmed processor receipts. Separate sandbox balances. Cash and manual sold reports never credit funds.
features.soldItems: Seller-only platform/cash modal closes inventory immediately and moves it to Sold Items; active orders/custody block unsafe manual changes.
features.marketplaceLocation: Server-side PostgreSQL bounding box and haversine distance, 5/15/30/50 miles or Nationwide. Local pickups prioritized; only city/state disclosed.
features.comicWorkshop: Compact specialist cards, actual ratings and services, studio photos, distance search, private inquiry and quote-backed booking.

referencePlatformIntegration.providers: Fixtures only; no real financial or external publishing operations

browser: Marketplace protection card and location/radius controls
Live GeoNames ZIP suggestion and radius selection
No horizontal marketplace overflow at the observed desktop viewport
Simplified Comic Workshop and preserved Upcoming navigation

weeklyReleaseSync.scope: Current/previous-week GCD releases only; resume job does not start another import
weeklyReleaseSync.honors: Owner pause, provider quotas and durable checkpoints

remaining.completeCatalog: Requires an official GCD snapshot archive. Current live directory contains 6,826 real records.
remaining.coverDisplay: 2,094 source references are stored; GCD image requests failed in this test browser. Reliable modern covers need an accessible authorized image source. Existing six local public-domain covers work.
remaining.realPaymentsAndVault: No live processor, carrier confirmation or physical inspection/custody service is connected. Real charges, withdrawals and verified-inspection claims stay disabled.
remaining.liveProviderTransactionTesting: Not performed because payment/provider credentials are absent. Processor workflows were tested with isolated receipts and fixtures.
remaining.QAAuthenticationUsers: Two clearly named QA authentication users remain for operator-managed retention; passwords and sessions were not saved.
